name: Lightning Gland
summary: In the Barrens, Lightning Glands are taken from stormhides roaming the plains. Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet needs them for trogg ale, a fiery brew Chen Stormstout taught him to make.

sections.title: A Shocking Ingredient
sections.body: Stormhides roam the Barrens savannas among other predators touched by the elements. Their flesh holds lightning glands, organs charged with latent electricity. These glands are poor fare on their own, but brewers prize them for the sting they bring to a brew.

sections.title: Drohn's Trogg Ale
sections.body: Brewmaster Drohn keeps Chen Stormstout’s brewing traditions alive in Ratchet. To make trogg ale, a potent brew, Drohn needs five lightning glands, a thunderhawk saliva gland, and a fresh kodo liver. The finished drink has a sharp kick that adventurers find invigorating and potent.

faq.answer: Stormhides roaming the Barrens savannas carry lightning glands.

faq.q: Who wants lightning glands and why?
faq.answer: Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet wants lightning glands for trogg ale, a recipe taught to him by the wandering brewmaster Chen Stormstout.

faq.q: What else is needed alongside the lightning gland?
faq.answer: Drohn needs five lightning glands, a thunderhawk saliva gland from greater thunderhawks, and a fresh kodo liver from the beasts of the Barrens.

angles.text: As a cook, you can see how Brewmaster Drohn and Chen Stormstout use raw beast organs in spirits, though lightning glands are not ordinary food.
